children.title: Supervisor: Preserve sandboxes on successful run completion to Review
children.intent: Modify finalize in src/supervisor.rs so that successful agent runs stop the agent process to halt billing while keeping the sandbox intact for Review and subsequent iterations.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked passes; supervisor unit tests verify that successful runs preserve the sandbox and stop the agent process.

children.title: Supervisor: Preserve parked sandboxes in Review and Ready during reconcile
children.intent: Update adoptable and reconcile in src/supervisor.rs so sandboxes for non-terminal cards (Review, Ready with environment) are preserved rather than reaped as orphans.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked passes; reconciliation unit tests verify that sandboxes for Review and Ready cards are kept during reconcile.

children.title: Supervisor: In-place sandbox reuse and branch refresh on card reclaim
children.intent: Update run_inside in src/supervisor.rs so claiming a card with a live environment sandbox reuses it in place (git fetch/rebase, new briefing) without delete/create, preserving WORKDIR build caches.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked passes; supervisor tests verify live sandbox reuse and in-place workspace refresh on card reclaim.

children.title: Store & Supervisor: Delete sandboxes on Done, Retired, and item deletion
children.intent: Trigger sandbox deletion and environment cleanup when a card reaches terminal states (Done, Retired/Cut) or is deleted.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked and cargo clippy --offline -- -D warnings pass; unit tests verify sandbox deletion on Done, Retired, and item deletion.
